risks.title: Dependence on GNSS systems and commercial signals
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the use of GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BDS, and other GNSS systems. Dependence on these systems, whose commercial access is free but potentially subject to changes or interruptions, represents a major technological risk. While the language intensity is moderate, the context of fundamental dependence for the majority of products justifies elevated severity.

risks.title: Risks related to global supply chains
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly detailed in this excerpt, worldwide manufacturing and distribution of electronic products inherently involves supply chain risks: delays, costs, and disruptions. This risk is universal for manufacturing technology companies and its severity is judged elevated given the scale of Garmin's operations.

risks.title: Intense competition in target markets
risks.score_rationale: Garmin operates in highly competitive markets: fitness, outdoor, aviation, marine, and auto OEM. The excerpt mentions a broad range of products and services, implying strong competitive pressure. Severity is moderate as Garmin appears well established, but competition remains a constant factor.

risks.title: Development and adoption of new technologies
risks.score_rationale: The company emphasizes its innovation history and continuous product development. The risk lies in the ability to remain at the forefront of technology amid rapid evolution and consumer adoption of potentially disruptive new solutions.

risks.title: Data security and user privacy
risks.score_rationale: With platforms like Garmin Connect and products collecting health and location data, data security is critical. While not explicitly detailed here, cybersecurity incidents represent a major risk for any technology company managing sensitive data.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party service providers
risks.score_rationale: Certain Garmin products rely on third-party services, notably for satellite connectivity and mapping content. The availability, cost, and terms of these services can impact Garmin's offerings.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Operating across various global markets: aviation, automotive, and others, Garmin is subject to various regulations. Non-compliance or regulatory changes could result in costs or restrictions.

ai_positioning.summary: No explicit mention or positioning regarding artificial intelligence in Garmin's 2025 10-K
